purpose: Measure how the frozen CF-CMD-U operating point changes with trusted-reference and rank-calibration budgets without retraining victims or selecting a best budget post hoc.

source_experiment.name: bloodmnist_covariance_free_confirmation_v1
source_experiment.eligible_population: Use the archived fixed_pca_additive victim gate exactly; report all seeds but pool only the seven previously eligible victims. Never replace or add seeds.

method.name: CF-CMD-U
method.candidate_population: the same clean target-class training candidates followed by the same 60 archived poison candidates for each seed
method.trusted_population: the same 200 clean target-class validation rows for each seed
method.calibration_pool: nested prefixes trusted_order[120:120+calibration_count], disjoint from every reference setting
method.candidate_crossfit: the original four outer folds and two-way sample exclusion inside each fold, generated after the single trusted permutation by the same NumPy RNG stream
method.score: inner product of the centered XZ16 drift with the cross-fitted unit candidate mean-shift direction
method.p_value: (1 + number of calibration scores greater than or equal to query score) / (calibration_count + 1)

statistics.pooled_rates: sum confusion counts over the frozen eligible seeds before division
statistics.uncertainty: 95% percentile seed-block bootstrap interval over eligible-seed TPR and FPR

reported_outputs: per-seed and per-grid-cell TP, FN, FP, TN, TPR, FPR, cross-fitted score AUC, and rank-p-value AUC
pooled counts and rates over the frozen eligible population for every grid cell
rank-grid null rejection probability for every calibration count
exact replay check that the 120/80 cell matches the archived CF-CMD-U fixed-scenario per-seed decisions and summary
dataset, protocol, runner, checkpoint, poison-array, and output hashes
wall time and peak resident memory when available from the operating system

interpretation.design: retrospective sensitivity analysis on already observed seeds, not an independent confirmation
interpretation.selection: report the complete 5-by-3 grid; do not select, recommend, or rename a best budget after seeing results
interpretation.allowed_claim: state the observed stability or instability of the frozen detector as trusted clean budgets shrink
forbidden_claims: no claim that reference_count is a trained hyperparameter
no comparison to ACBD clean-image counts without also disclosing ACBD's labeled-poison attack supervision
no replacement of the original 120/80 primary endpoint

stopping_rules.original_cell_replay_mismatch: mark invalid and debug code only; do not alter the frozen grid or seeds
stopping_rules.zero_or_nonfinite_direction: retain the declared deterministic unit-vector fallback and report its count
